title: Digitally-assisted structure design of a large-size proton exchange membrane fuel cell
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2024, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4EE04713C, Paper
Wenming Huo, Linhao Fan, Yunfei Xu, Mohamed Benbouzid, Wenzhen Xu, Fei Gao, Weizhuo Li, Nian Shan, Biao Xie, Haipeng Huang, Bohao Liu, Yassine Amirat, Chuan Fang, Xiaohui Li, Quanquan Gan, Feiqiang Li, Kui Jiao
A digitally-assisted method is proposed to accelerate the structure design of large-size proton exchange membrane fuel cells, including backward engineering and forward design.
